note: Both shortlist entries (ABM, UNFI) have change_expectation: null in 01-shortlist.json — triage_mode was 'skipped_small_universe' (universe of 2 eligible names carried straight through with no scout scoring), so no change_expectation was ever produced to plug into the formula. Rather than fabricate a value, the 0.20 weight on change_expectation was dropped and the remaining two weights renormalized to sum to 1: conviction 0.45/0.80=0.5625, evidence_completeness 0.35/0.80=0.4375. Both names are being sent to the panel regardless (panel.names=2, and only 2 dossiers exist), so this ranking only orders them, it does not gate anyone out on this basis.
formula: panel_priority = 0.5625*|preliminary_direction_score| + 0.4375*evidence_completeness   (renormalized; change_expectation term dropped, see note)
